name: input-text-typeahead
description: Provides a specialized input control intended for search-as-you-type scenarios

describedBy.description: It is used to establish a relationship between this component and another element. To facilitate correct screen reader behavior, the described-by attribute is copied to the aria-describedby attribute on the component's DOM element

labelHint.description: Represents a hint for oj-form-layout element to render a label on the editable component. This is used only if the editable component is added as a direct child to an oj-form-layout element

labelledBy.description: Property which is set automatically when the component is being labelled by an external oj-label. Consumers will not need to set this themselves

placeholder.description: The placeholder text to set on the element

required.description: Whether the component is required or optional

disabled.description: Whether the component is disabled. The default is false

disable.description: Whether the component is disabled. The default is false

clearIcon.description: Specifies if the clear icon should be visible

always.description: The clear icon is always visible

conditional.description: The clear icon is visible under the following conditions: if the component has a non-empty value AND it either has focus OR the mouse is over the field

never.description: The clear icon is never visible

instruction.description: Represents advisory information for the component, such as would be appropriate for a tooltip. This information is appended to the basic formatting information supplied for the URL type

helpHints.description: Represents hints for oj-form-layout element to render help information on the label of the component

definition.description: Hint for help definition text associated with the label

source.description: Hint for help source URL associated with the label

displayOptions.description: Display options for auxilliary content that determines where it should be displayed in relation to the component

converterHint.description: Display options for auxilliary converter hint text that determines where it should be displayed in relation to the component. When there is already a placeholder set on the component, the converter hint falls back to display type of 'notewindow'

helpInstruction.description: Display options for auxilliary help instruction text that determines where it should be displayed in relation to the component

messages.description: Display options for auxilliary message text that determines where it should be displayed in relation to the component

validatorHint.description: Display options for auxilliary validator hint text that determines where it should be displayed in relation to the component

validators.description: An optional set of validators to apply to the URL input. If supplied, this set of validators will replace the build-in validation based on the protocol, however, the implmentation of that internal validation is available in oj-ext-utils so that it can be explicitly added to the array here if required.  This allows consumers to have their own custom validators in addition to the default one

rawValue.description: The read-only intermediate value of the component updated as soon as the user finishes typing. Updates be made once the user stops typing for an interval of time as determined by the typeaheadWait property

typeaheadWait.description: Determines the length of a pause in typing that will trigger an update of the rawValue, by default, if the user does not press a further key for 400ms then the rawValue will be updated

valid.description: The current valid state of the component

invalidHidden.description: The component has invalid messages hidden and no invalid messages showing. An invalid message is one with severity 'error' or higher

invalidShown.description: The component has invalid messages showing. An invalid message is one with severity 'error' or higher

pending.description: The component is waiting for the validation state to be determined

userAssistanceDensity.description: Specifies the density of the form component's user assistance presentation

compact.description: Messages, help, hints, and required will not be shown inline; they will show in a mode that keeps the screen more compact, like a popup for the messages, and a required icon to indicate Required

efficient.description: Messages, help, hints, and required are all shown inline under the field with reserved space

reflow.description: Messages, help, hints, and required are all shown inline under the field with no reserved space

labelEdge.description: Defines how the label of a component is created

inside.description: The component creates the label using the label-hint attribute

none.description: The component will not have a label, regardless of whether it's in an oj-form-layout or not

provided.description: Label is provided by the parent if the parent is an oj-form-layout

validate.description: Validates the component's state. Returns Promise resolves to 'valid' if the value passed is valid. The Promise resolves to 'invalid' if the value passed is null, empty or invalid

contextMenu.description: Allows for the provision of a custom context menu on the input when in editable mode.  The menu is not displayed when the control is read-only. This slot must contain an oj-menu component if used

status.description: No longer supported on the underlying JET component
